content.short: ASXN publishes research and analytics dashboards covering Hyperliquid markets.
content.description: ASXN is a research outfit that maintains public dashboards alongside written analysis, with its Hyperliquid screener among the more widely used views of the network's markets. Hyperliquid's own builder documentation points to it first among perps and order book analytics tools. The research and the data work feed each other, which tends to produce dashboards built around questions people actually ask rather than whatever metrics were easiest to index.
